head.title: PC-R-09: WHO User Group and Country User Group
head.meta.title: PC-R-09: WHO User Group and Country User Group
head.meta.responsibilities: WHO User Group (WHOGroup): manages, edits, and owns (approves/rejects) product records in the Global Catalogue category (Catalogues -> WHO), which all users have permission to view., Country User Group (e.g., CAGroup, CBGroup): views, edits, and owns (approves/rejects) product records in its designated Country Catalogue category (Catalogues -> CA, Catalogues -> CB)., Country User Group: associates country catalogue products with Global Catalogue products or copies Trade Item data from the Global Catalogue into the national catalogue (Fig. 14)., Country User Group (WHO-hosted PCMT or in-country NPC tool): shares national Product Master Data back to the WHO Global Product Catalogue as a global good (Fig. 15).
